title: Tiger leaving the group chat
storyboard: Film: creator deadpan lip-syncs an 'I'm out' trending sound, then walks out of frame; cut to crate clip
caption:
Introvert icon, scientifically.

Being solitary doesn't mean silent: communication is a very important part of tiger life, through scent marks, scrapes and calls.
